Only 23% of remote jobs list pay—here’s what that means for you.

New data from Loker Dollar shows that out of 4,441 active remote listings, just 1,000 (23%) include a salary or hourly figure. The other 3,441 (77%) keep compensation private. But that doesn’t mean low wages—many firms expect candidates to negotiate.

Key numbers:
- 2,753 listings (62%) are open to worldwide applicants.
- 517 listings (12%) require AI skills; 416 (10%) seek leadership.
- 1,560 companies are hiring, including Neo Financial, TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether.
- Only Neo Financial discloses pay: $5 USD/hour for remote bilingual client services.

Communication tops skill demand (39%), followed by AI (12%).

Ready to find a USD-paying remote job? Browse the live board and filter for “worldwide remote” to see 2,753 open roles.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
